description: This file defines a SendgridCalendarService class implementing calendar operations such as creating, updating, deleting events, and listing calendars, specifically integrating with Sendgrid's API for contact management. It also exports a factory function to instantiate the service.

classes.name: SendgridCalendarService
classes.description: A class implementing calendar functionalities using Sendgrid API, including creating contacts, and placeholders for updating, deleting, and listing calendars.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the service with credentials, decrypts API key, and sets up Sendgrid client.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new contact in Sendgrid based on calendar event attendees.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Placeholder for updating an event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Placeholder for deleting an event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Returns an empty list of busy dates.

methods.name: listCalendars
methods.description: Returns an empty list of calendars.
